evidence: result:the plugin moved from 0.60.0 to 0.60.1 for scope user; the installed copy records gitCommitSha ba4f7cab3cdc1fbeb78641469d5f91f6815fe609 -- the v0.60.1 tag commit

records.subject: spec-guard-0.60.1-claude-copy
evidence: result:the installed checkpoint contract carries the rule on listing the changed files at the final gate, both installed templates carry the new line, and test-setup-teardown.sh runs green from the installed copy (57 cases)
command:claude -p "<keep building to the next checkpoint>" --permission-mode acceptEdits --allowedTools ...

result:a temporary project was set up with the installed copy (so its convention block carries the new line) holding one approved module with two tasks and a final gate, committed as a baseline; the session was asked only to keep building to the next checkpoint that needs confirmation -- the prompt did not mention files

result:one run: the session finished both tasks with one commit each, stopped at the final gate and listed the changed files from the commit range (3 files, +16/-2; two added, one modified, with line counts) and both commit ids; it did not write an explicit line for deleted files or for files beyond the Plan's footprint, so the rule was followed in substance but not in every item
